checksums.name: global_payload_jenkins_lookup2
checksums.formula_detail: Bob Jenkins lookup2 at FUN_08052f20: a=b=0x9e3779b9, c_init=0x805; per 12-byte block a+=LE32(p),b+=LE32(p+4),c+=LE32(p+8) then 9-step mix (a-=b;a-=c;a^=c>>13; b-=c;b-=a;b^=a<<8; c-=a;c-=b;c^=b>>13; a-=b;a-=c;a^=c>>12; b-=c;b-=a;b^=a<<16; c-=a;c-=b;c^=b>>5; a-=b;a-=c;a^=c>>3; b-=c;b-=a;b^=a<<10; c-=a;c-=b;c^=b>>15); tail c+=length, fold remaining (length mod 12) zero-padded LE words with Jenkins fall-through masking, final mix; return c (u32). Covered bytes are the RAM/logical payload only (header not covered); .sav must be decoded by reversing every 8-byte block before hashing. Stored little-endian at logical header+12; in physical .sav the 4 stored bytes appear at 0x1D0..0x1D3 in reversed-block (big-endian-looking) order.

checksums.name: slot_payload_jenkins_lookup2
checksums.formula_detail: Same FUN_08052f20 Jenkins lookup2 (a=b=0x9e3779b9, c_init=0x805), covered range is the 128-byte RAM slot payload at slot*0x98+0x18; stored little-endian at slot header+12 (logical offsets 0x00C/0x0A4/0x13C; physical .sav location is the same 8-byte block reversed). Only checked by FUN_08033e98 when header status==1; no occupied slot exists in the samples, so this instance is code-proven only.

io_driver_functions.notes: DMA3 transfer engine: programs DMA3 source/dest/count|0x80000000, waits DMA busy (0x8000); moves bitstreams between RAM/stack and EEPROM window 0x0D000000. Used for both read and write transfers.

EEPROM Read8: builds read-command bitstream (1,1 + address bits MSB-first), DMA address_bits+3 halfwords to 0x0D000000, DMA 0x44 halfwords back, reconstructs 4x u16 from serial LSBs in reverse word order. Direct callgraph caller is 0x08056558; FUN_0803e5fc loops it (text-traced).
EEPROM Write8: packs 4x u16 (64 bits MSB-first) + address bits + 0/1 bits, DMA address_bits+0x43 halfwords to 0x0D000000, polls EEPROM busy (0x0D000000 & 1) with timer timeout 0x88.
Verify8: read-back via FUN_08056334 and compare 4x u16; returns 0 or 0x8000.
Write+verify with up to 3 retries (FUN_080563e4 then FUN_08056558).
Block read (byte_offset, ram_dst, byte_len, err_out): loops FUN_08056334 per 8-byte block under FUN_0803fdc8/FUN_0803eda4(1..0) guards; returns 0/-1.
Block write: loops FUN_080565b0 per 8-byte block under same guards.
Jenkins lookup2 hash over a byte buffer; see checksums.
strcpy wrapper (FUN_08058298): copies ROM magic 'game002' into header+0.
strcmp wrapper (FUN_0805823c): compares header+0 against ROM magic.
EEPROM device-descriptor select (block count at descriptor+4, address-bit width at +8); FUN_0803e5e0 is the save-system EEPROM-type init.

open_questions: Slot payload (128B) internal field layout is unknown: its gameplay writer/serializer does not occur in the 266 decompiled functions and both samples have all slots empty (status 0, payload 0xFF).
Exact EWRAM/IWRAM addresses of RAM mirrors are unrecoverable from the corpus (buffers referenced only via unresolved _DAT literal-pool symbols, e.g. _DAT_08033cf0, _DAT_08034010, uRam08033f20).
Top-level callers/triggers of FUN_08033ca0, FUN_08033f24, FUN_08033f8c, FUN_0803440c, FUN_0803447c are unknown (UNRECOVERED_JUMPTABLE / indirect dispatch; callgraph lists no callers).

Semantics of global payload fields (+0 clamped 0..5, +2 clamped 0..2, +4/+8 clamped 0..256) and header fields A/B/C/D are constrained by clamps/defaults only; gameplay names are hypotheses to be settled by fuzzing.
Value of ROM constant _DAT_08034474 (factory default for global payload+0) is not in the corpus; observed cap-00 value -1 is consistent with it.
Meaning and producer of the FUN_080344dc flag (*_DAT_080344e8) gating invalid-state transitions on load failure.

Slot instance of the Jenkins checksum (FUN_08033e98, 0x80 bytes) and the lookup2 tail for non-zero tail words are code-proven only (CONFIRMED_STATIC) until an occupied-slot sample or fuzz test F9/F10 is run.
